notes.title: New Version(V2.6.0) Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Lords,


We are planning to conduct the update at 📌06:00 UTC on July 6th 📌which will last for an estimated 4-6 hours.  When the update is finished, a compensation reward will be sent.🤗🤗.
Check every detail about this update inside the patch notes and leave us your feedback below this post!  Please bind your account before the update starts to prevent losing your character.

Want to know more details? Check the  [url=https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7017837.html]Patch 2.6.0 Notes[/url]. Also welcome to visit our [url=https://www.facebook.com/InfinityKingdomOfficial/]facebook page[/url] to get more news! ːsteamthumbsupː

If you have any questions or concerns about this update, please let us know! Leave your opinions in the comment section. Your voice will be well heard! Wish you a good day and enjoy the journey in Infinity Kingdom!


Yours sincerely,
Infinity Kingdom Team
